body:
Think this has come up before.

Not pluralizing a plural (how are you arriving at that, in bake?) is the right thing to do.

@lorenzo Told me that I should update my ticket 

My issue is that when I baked a controller for Batsmen, I got a view variable called 'Batsmens' which then threw an error in the view.

To clarify, @davidyell's problem is this:

`bin/cake controller Batsmen`

`class Batsmens extends AppController`

Whereas the controller name should be taken almost verbatim instead of being "intelligently" inflected.
Oh no, the controller name is fine. It's actually `class BatsmenController extends AppController {`
ah... so where is the problem @davidyell ?
Probably a stray pluralize() floating around. I can take a look.
Thanks guys! Apologies for the messy ticket :smile:
